verdict.rationale: Featurebase's own site describes a feedback portal with in-app widgets where users vote on each other's ideas, alongside a public roadmap. Its API exposes feedback posts (submissions), which corroborates that customers can submit ideas. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the portal itself is publicly hosted (e.g. custom domain or anonymous access settings), in-depth portal setup documentation beyond marketing one-liners, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
